description: Source code for the IsolationInfo class and related functions in the net namespace, handling security and privacy context information for network requests.

classes.name: IsolationInfo
classes.description: Represents security and privacy context information for network requests, including origins, site for cookies, request type, and related cryptographic tokens.

classes.name: RequestType
classes.description: Enumeration for different types of network requests (MainFrame, SubFrame, Other).

classes.name: SiteForCookies
classes.description: Represents the site context for cookies, including origin and scheme.

classes.name: SchemefulSite
classes.description: Represents a site with scheme and origin, used for privacy and security checks.

classes.name: NetworkAnonymizationKey
classes.description: Key used to anonymize network requests for privacy, based on site and nonce.

methods.name: IsolationInfo::Create
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo object with specified request type, origins, site for cookies, party context, and nonce.

methods.name: IsolatonInfo::CreateTransient
methods.description: Creates a transient (ephemeral) IsolationInfo with opaque origins.

methods.name: IsolationInfo::CreateForInternalRequest
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo for internal requests with a given top frame origin.

methods.name: IsolationInfo::CreateIfConsistent
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo if the provided parameters are consistent.

methods.name: IsolationInfo::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the IsolationInfo object into a string.

methods.name: IsolationInfo::DebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the IsolationInfo.

methods.name: IsolatonInfo::CreateNetworkAnonymizationKeyForIsolationInfo
methods.description: Generates a NetworkAnonymizationKey based on the top frame and frame origins, and nonce.
